static_traits.name: Li Jie
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to confide in, but Reduced socializing gatherings due to stress related to the new house
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness history; without prior psychotherapy or help-seeking history
static_traits.language_features: Organized expression, active cooperation; able to describe triggering situations and impacts; repeatedly emphasizing worries, with catastrophic, future-predicting, black-and-white and other cognitive tendencies

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling overwhelmed and stressed since buying the first house. After learning the roof repair would cost $2,500, started believing this house would have problems one after another, often anticipating and fearing the next problem, Anxiety worsened and affecting daily life.
basic_info.core_demands: The persistent stress and Anxiety related to the new house have affected mental health and writing focus, so seeking counseling to relieve Anxiety and recover focus.

core_beliefs: The world is full of unpredictable problems, and I will eventually be unable to cope
One major mistake or costly problem means I made a wrong decision

special_situations.event: Learns that roof repairs will cost 2500 dollars
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a large repair bill appears, it means this house will keep having problems
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately goes online to look for DIY solutions and makes a detailed budget, worrying repeatedly in an attempt to prevent the worst case in advance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This house will become a bottomless pit, things will get worse, I cannot bear it

special_situations.event: When handling house-related tasks or bills
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot eliminate all potential risks, problems will definitely happen and exceed what I can bear
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly checking and rehearsing worst-case scenarios, postponing or avoiding activities to free up energy to watch for problems
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The next disaster is coming, I may not be able to handle it

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once a problem arises at home, it usually develops into the worst and the cost is high
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly rehearsing expensive repair scenarios in mind, saving and budgeting nervously for a rainy day
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The stove will most likely break down and need major repairs; the cost will crush me

special_situations.event: Recalls the home-buying decision and compares it with current problems
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one major problem occurs, it means the whole decision was wrong
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated self-doubt and regret, reducing investment in other areas such as writing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Buying this house was a huge mistake

core_conflict.wish: Longs for stability and controllability, hopes life is safe and predictable
core_conflict.fear: Fearing losing control and being crushed by successive problems, fearing being unable to bear the consequences
defense_goal: Reducing uncertainty through excessive worry and advance precautions
Maintains a sense of control through rational analysis, budgeting, and looking up DIY methods
Saving emotions and energy to cope with potential risks through Reduced socializing

object_relations.self_representation: An isolated and helpless Anxiety caretaker who needs to bear everything alone
object_relations.object_representation: An unpredictable environment/house that may develop problems at any time and bring high costs

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing sudden large repair bills or thinking of possible future house malfunctions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets the situation as an impending disaster, believing they will eventually be crushed (viewing the environment as a constant threat)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First acknowledging their stress and unease in a gentle, Empathy tone, then guiding them to identify emotions and conduct time-limited, structured reality testing and probability assessment, helping build a bridge between feelings and facts.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of potential risks and anticipating 'the next bad thing' will happen
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes one must prepare for all bad outcomes in advance, otherwise things will get out of control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Acknowledging their forward-looking advantage, tone stable, concretely guiding them to focus preparation on high-probability, controllable small steps, while limiting catastrophizing scenario rehearsal.

manifestations: After buying a first home, must bear repair decisions and financial consequences alone
High sensitivity to uncertainty and strong need for control
Constantly rehearsing the worst scenarios to avoid mistakes
Living alone, rarely discussing the extent of Anxiety with others
Reduced socializing gatherings due to stress, tending toward self-isolation
outcomes: Reduced social support, Anxiety maintained and amplified
Negative thinking loops harder to correct from outside

exception_events.target_problem: When handling house-related tasks or expenses, the client usually catastrophically anticipates and feels Persistent anxiety, then avoids socializing, with Decreased attention in writing.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once fixed a leaky faucet alone; the problem was solved and brought a sense of achievement, different from past cycles of worry, reflecting an experience of control and competence.
exception_events.reason: Clue: took concrete actionable steps and saw immediate results; the task was moderately difficult with clear boundaries, so this time did not fall into the catastrophic cycle.

exception_events.target_problem: When thinking new house malfunctions may appear, the client usually anticipates the worst outcome and keeps ruminating on worries, struggling to engage in daily activities.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Repainted the room with satisfying results, focused process, positive outcome, not dominated by 'the next disaster' thinking.
exception_events.reason: Clues: focused on the present task, broke down steps and took action; visible progress provided positive feedback, thereby weakening negative predictions.

positive_force: Has a certain problem-solving and hands-on ability (once fixed a faucet, successfully painted a room)
Willing to seek help and try structured methods (accepts decatastrophizing training and behavioral experiments)
Has habits of budgeting and information retrieval, which can be converted into reality testing and planning ability
Has some potential social support (a few friends to talk with)
negative_force: Significant cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, predicting the future, black-and-white thinking and overgeneralization
Reduced socializing due to stress, leading to insufficient external support and positive feedback
Persistent high vigilance and ruminative worry occupy attention, writing focus declines
Sleep and diet affected, further weakening emotional regulation and resilience

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated catastrophic worrying and anticipating the worst outcome
antecedent: When seeing house-related bills, repair notices, or doing home maintenance
Thinking about possible equipment failures (e.g. the furnace)
target_behavior.core_reason: One large repair expense triggers the belief in ongoing future problems, generalizing a single event into a long-term catastrophic trend.
target_behavior.function: Gaining a sense of control through advance worry and precautions, trying to avoid losses and uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety intensified, Sleep and diet affected, attention occupied making it hard to focus on writing

antecedent: When receiving social invitations or planning to go out during high-pressure periods
When needing to handle house matters and social arrangements simultaneously
target_behavior.core_reason: In order to save cognitive and emotional resources to deal with potential housing problems, worrying that socializing will aggravate the sense of losing control.
target_behavior.function: Escaping discomfort and reducing burden, to temporarily lower Anxiety levels
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support, negative thoughts lacking external correction, Loneliness and Anxiety maintained

target_behavior.behavior: Excessively looking up DIY solutions and detailed budgeting (safety behavior)
antecedent: When Anxiety thoughts about house problems arise
When planning or anticipating possible repair costs
target_behavior.core_reason: Trying to fully control uncertainty through information and planning, to avoid the worst scenario.
target_behavior.function: Briefly relieving Anxiety and gaining a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Time and energy occupied, the worry cycle reinforced, leading to Decreased writing efficiency and Anxiety hard to relieve fundamentally
